Meaning: Kind of line: ``AC`` (DC power flow with angles) or ``DC``.
The line is switchable: its on and off state is a decision of the model.
First year in which the line or pipe exists.
Last year in which the line or pipe exists.
Length of the line or pipe. When zero, it is computed from the node coordinates (``oM_Data_NodeLocation``).
Reactance of the line, used by the DC power flow; also read by the AC OPF analysis.
Resistance of the line, read by the AC OPF analysis only.
Transfer capacity in the forward direction.
Transfer capacity in the backward direction.
Share of the transfer capacity that may be used; it multiplies ``TTC`` and ``TTCBck``.
Investment cost of a candidate line or pipe; a positive value makes it a candidate.
Annualisation factor of the investment cost.
The build of a candidate line or pipe is all or nothing.
Lower bound of the build fraction of a candidate.
Upper bound of the build fraction of a candidate.
Minimum time a switchable line stays on.
Minimum time a switchable line stays off.
